source.account_notes: own order flow of the market-making bot (orderLinkId prefix 'mm')

structure.linear_note: perpetual (linear) records are a few hundred rows and are not analysed here
structure.records_are: one final-state snapshot per order; duplicate orderIds: 0

unfilled_window.why: Cancelled / Rejected orders are absent from the export before this point (only orders that filled survive), so cancel and reject rates are measured here and nowhere else. The real PostOnly reject rate on 2026-04-19..25 is therefore UNKNOWN, not zero.

fields_not_in_the_export.ack_time: no acknowledgement timestamp exists; see ack_latency_proxy for what is derivable
fields_not_in_the_export.cancel_sent_time: no cancel request timestamp exists, so cancel latency cannot be measured
fields_not_in_the_export.intermediate_updates: only the final state per order is stored (no New -> PartiallyFilled history)
fields_not_in_the_export.receive_side_timestamps: no client receive times; the exchange -> client leg is unmeasured
fields_not_in_the_export.disconnect_markers: no connection events; disconnects can only be suspected from activity gaps

ack_latency_proxy.definition: createdTime minus the client send stamp embedded in orderLinkId, milliseconds. One-way client-stamp -> exchange-created PLUS an unknown client/exchange clock offset. This is the quantity a backtest needs for 'order arrives at the matching engine'. It is NOT an ack round trip and says nothing about the exchange -> client leg.

validation_of_the_stamp_reading.note: if the stamp were not a client send time, gaps would scatter around zero including negatives
validation_of_the_stamp_reading.id_forms_note: the two forms are compared within the same day only, because latency differs by day

ack_latency_proxy.non_stationarity_note: the proxy's median moves from 17 ms to 73 ms across days (it contains the client/exchange clock offset, so a drifting offset and a real latency change cannot be told apart). A single pooled distribution hides this; stressed presets should cover the worst day.
ack_latency_proxy.by_status_note: status groups differ mostly because of WHEN they occurred (05-01 holds 405 of 596 rejects and is the slowest day), not because rejects take longer

ack_latency_proxy.by_coin_hour_note: cells with n < 30 carry n only
ack_latency_proxy.return_leg_reason: not in the export (no client receive times)

rejects.denominator_note: PostOnly orders created in the window (Filled + Cancelled + PartiallyFilledCanceled + Rejected)

other_reasons.interpretation: zero non-PostOnly rejects were observed; the data bound the rate, they do not measure it

cancel_latency.reason: the export has no cancel-request timestamp; updatedTime of a Cancelled order is the confirmation time and the send time is not recorded
cancel_latency.informational_note: this is order lifetime, driven by the strategy's own timeout, not a latency

definitions.filled_after_cancel_requested: orderStatus Filled with cancelType CancelByUser: a cancel was sent, the order filled anyway
definitions.cancel_found_nothing: orderStatus Filled with rejectReason EC_OrigClOrdIDDoesNotExist: the cancel / amend reached the exchange after the order was gone
definitions.partial_then_cancelled: orderStatus PartiallyFilledCanceled: some fill, then cancelled; whether the fill came after the cancel was sent is not recorded

last_fill_to_cancel_confirmed_ms.suppressed_reason: fewer than {'p50': 30, 'p90': 30, 'p99': 100} samples required per percentile

cancel_fill_races.race_share_note: numerator = filled orders that carry evidence of a cancel; denominator = every cancel attempt that left a trace in the window. A cancel sent to an order that filled normally leaves no trace only when it also found nothing, so this is a lower bound on the true race share.

disconnect_candidates.definition: interval with no order create / fill / final-update event on ANY of the 22 symbols
disconnect_candidates.interpretation: CANDIDATES ONLY. The export cannot tell a connection loss from an idle bot or a quiet market; a final-state record carries no heartbeat. No disconnect rate is derived from this.
disconnect_candidates.reason_null: not observable from final-state order records
